title: Newsletter Configuration
description: Schema for configuring an UnlockOpen newsletter that fetches from Raindrop.io and drafts via Buttondown

name.description: URL-safe slug used for directory names and identification

title.description: Human-readable newsletter title, used in subject lines and headings

description.description: Optional intro text rendered at the top of each issue

schedule.description: Publishing cadence, determines the output directory period format

collectionId.description: Raindrop.io collection ID. Use 'unlock-newsletter collections' to discover IDs

tags.description: Filter raindrops by these tags (combined with OR logic)

limit.description: Maximum number of items to fetch per request

sections.description: Optional named sections to group items by tag. Items are placed in the first matching section

name.description: Section heading in the rendered newsletter

tags.description: Tags that place an item into this section

baseDir.description: Base output directory. Newsletters are written to {baseDir}/{name}/{period}/newsletter.md

template.description: Nunjucks template name (without .njk extension) from the templates/ directory

raindrop_token.description: 1Password secret reference for the Raindrop.io API token

buttondown_token.description: 1Password secret reference for the Buttondown API key
